# GKHT Exotics

> Owner-operated exotic and luxury car rental in Los Angeles, Phoenix/Scottsdale, Miami and San Francisco. 81 vehicles from $250/day, delivered to your hotel, home or venue. 63 of 81 vehicles rent to drivers 18 and older and another 12 at 21+, with no young-driver fee. Owned by Garrett Leake (@gkht). Call or text (213) 845-5211.

## Key facts
- Minimum age: 18+ on 63 vehicles, 21+ on 12, 25+ on the rest (shown on every vehicle page)
- No young-driver surcharge: the listed daily rate is the rate at any age
- Requirements: valid driver's license, full comprehensive & collision insurance in the renter's name, refundable security deposit ($800–$2,000, listed per vehicle)
- Delivery: hotel, home, venue or airport in each metro (fees may apply outside the metro)
- Rating: 5.0 on Google (5 reviews)
- Contact: (213) 845-5211 · contact@gkhtexotics.com · https://gkhtexotics.com/contact

## Locations
- Los Angeles, CA: 39 self-drive vehicles, from $450/day; 39 available at 18+
- Phoenix / Scottsdale, AZ: 22 self-drive vehicles, from $250/day; 4 available at 18+, 12 more at 21+
- Miami, FL: 14 self-drive vehicles, from $400/day; 14 available at 18+
- San Francisco, CA: 4 self-drive vehicles, from $320/day; 4 available at 18+
